wsjHeadlines.title: Wall Street Is Starting to Call the Shots in America’s AI Build-Out

wsjHeadlines.title: Behind the Scenes of Crypto’s Biggest Nightmare: a Record-Breaking Cyber Heist
wsjHeadlines.description: Binance’s founder Changpeng Zhao had warned a week earlier that “No crypto wallet is 100% safe.” In 20 minutes, hackers had made off with at least $6.3 billion.

wsjHeadlines.title: Hedge Fund Arini Offloads $800 Million in Debt as Losses Deepen
wsjHeadlines.description: Hamza Lemssouguer’s fund known for its bold bets suffered margin calls after several investments tumbled.

wsjHeadlines.title: Cracks in AI Trade Power Sharp Tech Selloff
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Binance executives are racing to cover billions in losses from the biggest crypto heist in history, and Ukraine struck a Russian oil refinery.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Week the Cracks in the AI Trade Grew Deeper
wsjHeadlines.description: Intel suffered its worst-ever daily decline as investors’ anxieties hit new highs.

wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Fed officials signal rate-hike support and Treasurys gain on tech selloff

wsjHeadlines.description: The media conglomerate’s goodwill alone exceeds its stock-market value.

wsjHeadlines.description: The tech giant is no longer loved by investors, despite its many advantages.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Boom Drives a Jump in Lending, but Bankers Still Sound Cautious
wsjHeadlines.description: Big and regional banks alike are riding a wave of AI lending.

wsjHeadlines.description: The AI developer’s losses were the flip side of the big gains for Amazon and Alphabet.

wsjHeadlines.description: The British high-street bank’s shares dropped after it forecast weaker-than-expected interest income next year.

wsjHeadlines.description: The Dutch bank launched a new buyback program of $1.84 billion and set out plans to restructure its wholesale banking unit.

wsjHeadlines.title: Societe Generale Posts Profit, Revenue Increase in Third Quarter
wsjHeadlines.description: The lender reported third-quarter net profit that beat market expectations despite a volatile macroeconomic backdrop in its home country.

wsjHeadlines.title: UBS CEO Signals Possible Switzerland Exit Over Capital Demands
wsjHeadlines.description: The group is caught in a dispute with lawmakers in its home country over proposals to introduce more demanding capital requirements on its foreign subsidiaries.

wsjHeadlines.description: The bank hasn’t disclosed the building’s definitive cost since it opened last year.

wsjHeadlines.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech, Media & Telecom Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Intel, Amazon and more in the latest Market Talks covering technology, media and telecom.

wsjHeadlines.title: Affordable Care Act Rates to Rise Steeply—Again
wsjHeadlines.description: ACA plan premiums will rise by 13% in 2027, the second straight year of double-digit increases in a market that is already facing shrinking enrollment.

wsjHeadlines.title: Global Bond Yields Fall Sharply in October Amid Flight to Safety
wsjHeadlines.description: Global bond yields were poised to end October sharply lower as a flight to safety revived demand for government debt, even as markets braced for higher short-term borrowing from the U.S. Treasury.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Slide as Amazon, Intel Earnings Spark More AI Selling
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks fell as the AI selloff began to feed on itself following more disappointing earnings reports from Amazon and Intel, leaving investors to wonder if the tech correction could become a speculative bust.

wsjHeadlines.title: Auto & Transport Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Hyundai Motor, Volvo Car, Renault and more in the latest Market Talks covering the auto and transport sector.

wsjHeadlines.title: Deepening Tech Selloff Pushes Nasdaq Toward Its Worst Month in Over a Year
wsjHeadlines.description: The tech selloff intensified after results from Amazon and Intel compounded worries around the AI trade.

wsjHeadlines.title: If History Repeats, Small Caps Will Win in a Landslide
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Halloween came early for tech giants.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Indexes Largely Lower as AI Selloff Bites
wsjHeadlines.description: European equities retreated broadly, pressured by surging oil prices and fresh selloffs across AI-linked tech stocks.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | An AI Halloween Market Scare
wsjHeadlines.description: Crypto isn’t risk-free after all, as thieves take Binance for $6.3 billion.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Anthropic’s IPO Will Be a National-Security Win for Taiwan
wsjHeadlines.description: Reliance on the island for AI chip production puts it among America’s top foreign policy interests.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | How Do Investors Measure ‘Social Impact’?
wsjHeadlines.description: Developing a common standard would be one of the best ways of expanding economic opportunity.

wsjHeadlines.description: Prediction markets like Kalshi are fundamentally different from sportsbooks and offer public benefits.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Anthropic’s Big IPO Gamble
wsjHeadlines.description: The company says it could save humanity or destroy it. Investors, place your bets.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Markets Don’t Vote for Lula in Brazil
wsjHeadlines.description: The country’s stocks, bonds and currency plunge after the socialist wins.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Fall on Mild Weather Outlook
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures settled lower, falling for a third consecutive week as the first significant cold weather of the season has yet to show up.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold and Silver Futures Fall to 1-Year Lows
wsjHeadlines.description: Precious metals futures fell as conflicts in the Middle East and Russia-Ukraine push oil prices higher, fueling concerns about inflation and higher interest rates.

wsjHeadlines.title: Lithium Miners Look Past Falling Prices to Expand Output
wsjHeadlines.description: After regaining their footing following a two-year slump, lithium prices have dropped sharply in recent weeks. That isn’t restraining miners’ ambitions.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Ticks Back Up as Uncertainty Clouds Peace Hopes
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil prices gained in early Asia trade after settling lower on hopes of U.S.-Iran talks.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Settles Lower As U.S. Seeks to Engage Iran in Talks
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures retreated on news that the U.S. is seeking to establish talks with Iranian hard-liners, although concerns of renewed military conflict kept losses to a minimum.

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Rises 0.04% This Month to 97.08
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index edged lower, down for three consecutive trading days.

wsjHeadlines.title: Cryptocurrencies Pare Losses After $6.3 Billion Hack Spooks Markets
wsjHeadlines.description: Bitcoin and Ethereum clawed back some ground after tumbling more than 3% each on news of the major breach at the world’s biggest crypto exchange.
